license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry, as defined by this act, unless he shall first obtain a license so to do as provided in this act.

issuing_authority.quote: Every person, except as hereinafter provided, desiring to commence the practice of podiatry within this state shall make written application to the state board of podiatry

age_minimum.quote: Each applicant shall be at least twenty-one (21) years of age

moral_character_required.quote: shall not have been convicted, found guilty, or received a withheld judgment or a suspended sentence in this state or in any other state of a crime that is deemed relevant in accordance with section 67-9411(1), Idaho Code

degree_required.value: Graduate of a reputable school of podiatry requiring four full years of study
degree_required.quote: shall be a graduate of some reputable school of podiatry accredited by the board. A reputable school of podiatry for the purposes herein shall mean a school of podiatry requiring for graduation the graduation from an accredited high school, credits granted for at least two (2) full years of general college study in a college or university of recognized standing, and four (4) full years of study in such school of podiatry or its equivalent.

accrediting_body.quote: shall be a graduate of some reputable school of podiatry accredited by the board

required.quote: shall have completed an accredited podiatric residency as defined by board rule

kind.quote: shall have completed an accredited podiatric residency as defined by board rule

exams.name: Competency exam approved by board rule
exams.notes: Tests for entry level competency to provide podiatric medical services
exams.quote: Each applicant shall take and pass a competency exam approved by board rule. The examination shall test for entry level competency to provide podiatric medical services.

interval_years.quote: All licenses issued under the provisions of this chapter shall be subject to biennial renewal

required.quote: satisfactory evidence of having complied with continued education requirements as established by board rule are conditions precedent for issuance of a license

available.quote: The board may issue a license to an applicant by endorsement where the applicant has passed an examination for and is currently licensed to practice podiatry in another state.

requirements.value: Applicant must be currently licensed in another state and satisfy all other requirements for licensure in Idaho
requirements.quote: The applicant must satisfy in all other respects the requirements for licensure in this act and any rules adopted by the board.

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry, as defined by this act, unless he shall first obtain a license so to do as provided in this act.

title_protection.quote: who uses the title chiropodist, podiatrist, or any other word, title or abbreviation calculated to induce belief that he is engaged in the practice of podiatry, or who holds himself out to the public as diagnosing the ailments of or treating in any manner the human foot by medical, physical or surgical methods, without a license as provided in this act, shall be deemed guilty of a misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices or attempts to practice podiatry, publicly advertises as a podiatrist, or who uses the title chiropodist, podiatrist, or any other word, title or abbreviation calculated to induce belief that he is engaged in the practice of podiatry ... without a license as provided in this act, shall be deemed guilty of a misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty of a crime deemed relevant under Idaho Code
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Found guilty by a court of competent jurisdiction of a crime that is deemed relevant in accordance with section 67-9411(1), Idaho Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated and excessive abuse of any drug, alcohol, or controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Found by the board to be a repeated and excessive abuser of any drug, including alcohol, or any controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the podiatry chapter or rules promulgated thereunder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Found by the board to be in violation of any provision of this chapter or the rules promulgated pursuant thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used fraud or deception in procuring any license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Found by the board to have used fraud or deception in the procuring of any license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had any adverse action taken against the licensee by a peer review body, health care institution, professional society, or governmental agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Found by the board to have had any action, including denial of a license or the voluntary surrender of or voluntary limitation on a license, taken against the licensee by any peer review body, any health care institution, any professional medical society or association or any court, law enforcement or governmental agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unethical, unprofessional, or dishonorable conduct in the practice of healing the sick
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Found by the board to have been unethical, unprofessional or dishonorable in the practice of healing the sick

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with an order issued by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Found by the board to have failed to comply with an order issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering gifts or receiving rebates/commissions for patient procurement or prescribing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offer, give or promise, either directly or indirectly, any gift in return for the procurement of a patient or patients for podiatric treatment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing secret remedial agents or guaranteeing any treatment or remedy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribe, dispense or pretend to use, in treating any patient, any secret remedial agent, or manifest or promote its use in any way, or guarantee or imply to guarantee any treatment, therapy or remedy whatsoever.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using any form of advertising that is false, misleading, or deceptive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use any form of advertising that is false, misleading or deceptive.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using any title other than podiatrist or doctor of podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use any title other than that of podiatrist or doctor of podiatric medicine
Employ a solicitor or solicitors to obtain business.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing or using untruthful or improbable statements to deceive or defraud the public or patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publish or use untruthful or improbable statements with the intent of deceiving or defrauding the public or any patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any board rule prescribing standards for ethical practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violate any rule promulgated by the board which prescribes the standards for the ethical practice of podiatry in this state.

definition_quote.value: Podiatry shall, for the purpose of this chapter, mean the diagnosis and mechanical, electrical, medical, physical and surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg, and the casting of feet for the purpose of preparing or prescribing corrective appliances, prosthetics, and/or the making of custom shoes for corrective treatment
definition_quote.quote: Podiatry shall, for the purpose of this chapter, mean the diagnosis and mechanical, electrical, medical, physical and surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg, and the casting of feet for the purpose of preparing or prescribing corrective appliances, prosthetics, and/or the making of custom shoes for corrective treatment

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis and mechanical, electrical, medical, physical and surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg

drug_authority.value: A podiatrist may administer narcotics and medications in the treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg in the same manner as a physician and surgeon
drug_authority.quote: A podiatrist may administer narcotics and medications in the treatment of ailments of the human foot and leg in the same manner as a physician and surgeon licensed to practice under chapter 18, title 54, Idaho Code.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: Surgical treatment, as herein used, shall mean the surgical treatment of the foot and ankle and those soft tissue structures below the knee governing the function of the foot and ankle, but shall not include the amputation of the leg, surgery of the knee joint, surgery of the bony structures proximal to the distal half of the tibia

amputation_authorized.quote: shall not include the amputation of the leg

anesthesia_authority.quote: shall not include ... the administration or monitoring of general anesthesia

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: Surgical treatment, as herein used, shall mean the surgical treatment of the foot and ankle

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: Advanced surgical procedures, as determined by the state board of podiatry, shall be performed in a licensed hospital or certified ambulatory surgical center accredited by the joint commission on accreditation of healthcare organizations or the accreditation association for ambulatory health care where a peer review system is in place.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: It is not the intent of this section, and nothing herein shall be so construed, to prohibit the sale of noncustom built shoes that are commonly sold by merchants in commercial establishments.
